en: Jupiter is so large that approximately 1,300 Earths could fit inside its massive volume.
The average distance from the Earth to the Moon is about 384,400 kilometers.
On the Mohs hardness scale, a diamond ranks at a perfect 10 while talc ranks at 1.
About 97 percent of all the water on Earth is found in the salty oceans.
The Sun is approximately 150 million kilometers away from the Earth.
Sand particles measure up to 2 millimeters across, while clay particles are smaller than 0.002 millimeters.
The most powerful earthquake ever recorded was the 1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile, measuring 9.5 in magnitude.
A Category 5 typhoon has maximum sustained winds of at least 185 kilometers per hour.
Proxima Centauri is the closest star to our solar system, located about 4.24 light-years away.
The Earth's crust is very thin, averaging only about 5 to 70 kilometers in thickness.
The average annual temperature in the tropical climate of the Philippines is about 27 degrees Celsius.
Pumice is a volcanic rock with a density under 1 gram per cubic centimeter, allowing it to float on water.
